body.x: Dongyang Mirae University, participated ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ held at COEX in Samseong-dong from October 17th (Tue) to 20th (Fri) and exhibited student excellent works with the 35 th Graduation Work Exhibition.

Dongyang Mirae University, is the specialized university that cultivates professional occupation manpower that the country and society needs with the vision of Asia’s occupation education hub university.

It has attended this exhibition with the name of ‘the 35 th graduation work exhibition’ to introduce excellent works developed by project type education of school students to the internal and external exhibitors.

The official of Dongyang Mirae University said, “The period for the occupation to produce and disappear is getting shorter in 21 st century. Many technologies are changing compositively, new technologies are being made, therefore, we aim to contribute to the society by reborning as the talent by acquiring technology that leads the era by having correct values through school education.
